label: Country State Code
description: Unique identifier for a country-state unit; join key across datasets.

label: Governor Given Name(s)
description: Given name(s) of the sitting governor.

label: Governor Surname(s)
description: Surname(s) of the sitting governor.

label: Start Date of Governor Term
description: Date the governor's term began.

label: End Date of Governor Term
description: Date the governor's term ended.

label: Governor Gender
description: Gender of the governor.

label: Governor Party
description: Party of the governor.

label: Governor Early Exit
description: Whether/why the governor left office before the term's scheduled end.

label: Governor Reelection
description: Count of consecutive reelections for the incumbent governor.

label: Governor Turnover
description: Whether the governorship changed party control.

label: Cumulative Changes of Governor
description: Running count of governor changes in the state.

label: Governor Years in Power
description: Cumulative years the incumbent party has held the governorship.

label: Effective Number of Parties (executive)
description: Effective number of parties (Laakso and Taagepera, 1979) for the executive race.

label: Effective Number of Parties (votes)
description: Effective number of parties based on vote shares.

label: Seats of Incumbent in Chamber
description: Number of legislative seats held by the incumbent (governor's) party.

label: Seats of Opposition in Chamber
description: Number of legislative seats held by the opposition.

label: Effective Number of Parties (seats)
description: Effective number of parties based on seat shares.

label: SUR Index (Giraudy 2015)
description: Subnational Undemocratic Regime index; higher = more democratic/competitive.

label: SEDI (executive)
description: Subnational Electoral Democracy Index for the executive dimension.

label: Turnover (executive)
description: Executive turnover component of subnational democracy.

label: Contestation (executive)
description: Executive contestation component of subnational democracy.

label: Contestation (legislative)
description: Legislative contestation component of subnational democracy.

label: President Name
description: Name of the sitting national executive (president).

label: President Party Abbreviation
description: Party abbreviation of the sitting president.
